violations.description: Food supplies. — --Food item obtained from unapproved source. Not For Sale meat in freezer.

Preventing contamination during storage. — --Food item was not stored in a clean, dry location a minimum of 6 inches above the floor. Observed food boxes on floor in freezer. Food items need to be 6 inches off floor.

Preventing contamination from equipment, utensils, and wiping cloths. — --Cloth for wiping food spills was not stored in sanitizing solution (at proper concentration) between uses. No sanitizer being used

Date marking and disposition of ready-to-eat potentially hazardous food. — --Refrigerated, ready-to-eat potentially hazardous food (prepared more than 24 hours ago) was not properly date marked. Observed hamburger meat and other meat products stored with no date marking.

Clean-in-place (CIP) equipment - Design and construction. — --Nonfood contact surface of clean in place equipment did not meet proper design and/or construction characteristics. Fan in walk in freezer did not have a protected shield.
Cleaning frequency of equipment and utensils. — --Ventilation hood system was not cleaned properly and/or as frequently as required. Observed filters in ventilation system contained layers of grease.
Manual cleaning and sanitizing requirements. — --An approved sanitizer was not used during three compartment sink operation. No sanitizer in use.

Cleaning and maintenance of floors, walls and ceilings. — --Physical facilities (e.g. floors, walls, ceiling etc…) were not clean or not cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. Observed food splashed on walls, floors has build up of food.

Lighting. — --Lighting did not have protective shielding in areas where there is exposed food, clean equipment/utensils, or unwrapped single-service items . Light in walk in freezer does not have shield.

Preventing contamination of packaged and unpackaged food. — --Food removed from original packaging was not placed in a clean and sanitized container. Sausage, onions, tomato, meat not stored in container.

Date marking and disposition of ready-to-eat potentially hazardous food. — --Refrigerated, ready-to-eat potentially hazardous food (prepared more than 24 hours ago) was not properly date marked. Items not date marked in cooler.
Temperature measuring devices. — --Temperature measuring device was not provided. Coolers/freezers missing temperature measuring devices.

Cleaning frequency of equipment and utensils. — --Nonfood contact surface was not cleaned as frequently as required. Freezers and cooler needs cleaning.--Ventilation hood system was not cleaned properly and/or as frequently as required. Filters in hood system needs to be cleaned. Build up of grease in filters.

Storage of cleaned equipment and utensils. — --Clean equipment/utensil was not stored in a clean, dry manner to protect from contamination. Divider between garbage can and shelve it broken off in places. Bowls sitting next to divider/garbage can. Not protected from contamination.

Cleaning and maintenance of floors, walls and ceilings. — --Physical facilities (e.g. floors, walls, ceiling etc…)were not clean or not cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. Walls and ceiling needs cleaning.
